name: Peasant Farmer
description: Works agricultural fields, pastures, and orchards.

name: Artisan Craftsman
description: Operates workshops, mills, and kilns to refine raw goods.

name: Quarry Miner
description: Digs deep into mountain veins and rock quarries.

name: Master Mason
description: Erects buildings and maintains structural integrity.

name: Market Trader
description: Manages market stalls, warehouses, and trade caravans.

name: City Watchman
description: Patrols towns and garrisons to keep unrest in check.

name: Town Scribe
description: Keeps tax ledgers and administers civic offices.
